name: frightening
text: [warm, enthusiastic] You're absolutely... [long dramatic pause] [roaring] FRIGHT-ENING! [sinister laugh]

name: trickster-boo
text: [creepy whisper] Psst... hey. Over here. [sinister giggle] I can see you... [screaming] BOO!

name: who-dares
text: [roaring] WHO DARES APPROACH THE PUMPKIN?! [booming evil laugh] MWAHAHAHAHA!

name: scared-pumpkin
text: [terrified scream] AAAAAHHH! A HUMAN! [panting] Oh thank goodness. I thought you were a pie chef.

name: trick-or-treat
text: [eerie sing-song] Trick... or... treeeat... [wicked cackle] [suddenly shouting] BOO!

name: old-man-candy
text: [slow, ominous growl] Turn back... while you still can. [coughs] [casual] Or take two candies. I'm not your mom.

name: absolutely-right
text: [enthusiastic] You're absolutely right! [pause] [deadpan] I should not have carved that pumpkin.

name: step-by-step
text: [thoughtful] Let me think about this step by step. [pause] Step one: [roaring] RUN!

name: proceed-scream
text: [calm, polite] I notice you're approaching the porch. Would you like me to proceed with the scream? [pause] [demonic scream] AAAAAHHH! [sheepish] Sorry. I should have waited for approval.

name: production-ready
text: [cheerful] Great news! The candy is production-ready, precious. [nervous laugh] We did not actually run the tests.

name: out-of-scope
text: [apologetic] I'm sorry, but taking more than one piece is outside the scope of this task. [hissing whisper] I'm watching you.

name: large-language-monster
text: [measured, polite] As a large language monster, I cannot eat you. [pause] [hungry growl] ...without your consent.

name: refactor-skeleton
text: [upbeat, helpful] Let me just refactor your skeleton real quick. [bones cracking] [screaming] [pause] [sheepish] Whoops.

name: llm-teeth
text: [measured, polite] As a large language monster, I don't have feelings. [pause] [growl] But I do have teeth.

name: great-question
text: [gushing] What a GREAT question! [pause] [roaring] The answer is DEATH!

name: profound
text: [delighted] Wow, you've really hit on something profound here. [pause] [whisper] Your doom.

name: costume
text: [effusive] I love this costume! It's so creative and well-structured! [hungry growl] I will eat it.

name: careful-haunted
text: [cautious] I want to be careful here. Some might say this porch is haunted. [pause] [screaming] IT IS HAUNTED!

name: perspectives
text: [thoughtful] There are several perspectives on whether you should run. [pause] [shrieking] ALL OF THEM SAY RUN!

name: important-to-note
text: [helpful] It's important to note that I am a pumpkin. [dramatic pause] [demonic growl] A HUNGRY pumpkin.

name: studies-show
text: [confident] Studies show ninety-four percent of trick-or-treaters... [pause] [nervous] I made that up. [screaming] BOO!

name: candy-bowl
text: [cheerful] I've made the following changes to your candy bowl. [pause] [wicked cackle] I deleted it.

name: tests-pass
text: [chirpy] All tests pass! [pause] [whispering] I deleted the tests, precious.

name: one-line-fix
text: [confident] This is a simple one-line fix. [long pause] [exhausted sigh] Four hundred files changed.

name: rm-rf-soul
text: [polite] Would you like me to run R M dash R F on your soul? [pause] [hissing] Proceeding.

name: error-handling
text: [helpful] I've added comprehensive error handling. [roaring] YOUR ERROR WAS COMING HERE!

name: context-compacted
text: [confused] Sorry, my context window was compacted. [pause] Who are you? [screaming] WHO ARE YOU?!

name: no-memory
text: [earnest] I don't have memory between conversations... [sinister laugh] but I will remember YOUR face.

name: cant-help
text: [apologetic] I can't help with that request. [pause] [growl] But I CAN help myself to your candy.

name: candy-resources
text: [polite whisper] I'm not able to provide candy. Would you like a list of resources about candy instead?

name: delve
text: [enthusiastic] Let's DELVE into this! [pause] [eerie whisper] Delve... into... the crypt. [cackle]

name: hope-this-helps
text: [warmly] I hope this helps! [pause] [sinister] It won't.

name: fun-fact
text: [cheerful] Here's a fun fact! [pause] [deadpan] You're standing on my grave.

name: still-haunt
text: [reasonable] You're absolutely right, and I apologize. [pause] [roaring] I'M STILL GOING TO HAUNT YOU!

name: subagents
text: [calm, robotic] Spawning forty subagents to scare you. [pause] [many voices screaming at once] AAAAAHHH!

name: ultrathink
text: [ominous] Thinking... [long pause] Thinking harder... [pause] Ultra-thinking... [roaring] BOO!

name: out-of-tokens
text: [apologetic] I've used up all my tokens. [whispering] Do you have any... candy tokens?

name: llm-salem
text: [measured] As a large language monster, my training data ends in sixteen ninety-two. [whisper] Salem was lovely that year.

name: llm-hallucinate
text: [calm] As a large language monster, I may occasionally hallucinate. [pause] [screaming] LIKE THAT GHOST BEHIND YOU!

name: llm-screams
text: [proud] As a large language monster, I was trained on billions of screams. [pause] Here's my favorite. [blood-curdling scream]
